d:
Svadisht aur heldi ragi dhokla (Ragi Dhokla). ragi, nachni yani Finger Millet se bana yah dhokla naram, spanji aur bahut svadisht hai. nashte ya halke snaik ke lie yah ek behatrin Healthy Millet Recipe hai. ye kailshiyam, aayran aur phaibar ka behatrin srot hai. roj ke nashte men kuchh heldi aur svadisht banana chahte hain? to ye Millet Dhokla jarur traee karen.
Ingredients for Ragi Dhokla Recipe
For Millet Dhokla
Ragi aata - Ragi Flour - ¾ cup
Suji - Semolina - ¾ cup
Namak - Salt - 1 tsp
Dahi - Curd - 1 cup
Adrak mirch pest - Ginger Chilli Paste - 1 tsp
